profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at IBM, ASF Member.
profile.summary:
Software Engineer, architect, and advanced technical support.

At the Apache Software Foundation, I served as the chair of the HTTP Server project from 2011 to 2017.  I'm a PMC member on a handful of projects, and a member of the foundation.

At IBM, I work on lots of different things in the WebSphere Application Server organization, including architectural responsibility for Edge components as well as leading the development team of IBM HTTP Server, IBM's commercial distribution of Apache HTTP Server for IBM products.  I'm also the WebSphere Application Server Sustaining Engineering (L3) architect.

I've worked with countless customers through critical situations to resolve issues in the areas of Security, TCP, HTTP, SSL/TLS, LDAP, Apache, and other proxy servers.

Specialties: IBM HTTP Server,  Apache HTTP Server development, JSR299, Contexts and Dependency Injection (CDI) for Java, SSL/TLS, HTTP, X509, GSKit, TCP, LDAP, Linux, Open Source Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
My primary responsibility is leading the architecture, development, and backend (L3) support of IBM HTTP Server, the Apache-based HTTP server included many IBM products including WebSphere Application Server (WebSphere) and the z/OS mainframe operating system.  This includes advanced technical support to customers experiencing problems in complex, multi-vendor topologies that support their use of WebSphere.

I additionally serve as the architect for various edge-of-network components in WebSphere Application Server and as the L3 (sustaining engineering) Architect for WebSphere Application Server (and related products). 

I also have a formal position on a small team responsible for technical security incident response for WebSphere Application Server.

I am a recognized as a focal point and subject matter expert within my organization in IBM for HTTP/TLS/TCP, native (non-java) programming, security/vulnerability handling, support, and Linux.

positions.title: ASF Developer and Member
positions.description: I am a committer and PMC member on the Apache HTTP Server,  Apache Portable Runtime, and OpenWebBeans (Java Contexts and Dependency Injection) projects, and a member of the Apache Software Foundation.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect and lead Development/L3 engineer for IBM HTTP Server (IBM's commercial distribution of Apache HTTP Server)

I also serve as the WebSphere focal point for Linux and WebSphere Portal, am a voting member on the board responsible for addressing security/integrity problem reports, and have architectural responsibility for a variety of edge-of-network components of WebSphere Application Server

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and tested an implementation of "Contexts and Dependency Injection for Java" (JSR299) based on the Apache OpenWebBeans project where I am a PMC member.

My primary areas of focus were CDI Interceptors and CDI/EJB integration in a commercial application server.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and provided L3 support for IBM's commercial distribution of Apache HTTP Server, IBM HTTP Server, provided as an element of WebSphere Application Server and z/OS

Maintained, enhanced, and extended automated JUnit-based regression test suite.

Responsible for creation, documentation, and execution of Functional Verification Test (FVT) for WebSphere Commerce and WebSphere Commerce Digital Media Enabler.


Actively participated in open-source development and review at the Apache Software Foundation.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for software and hardware maintenance of a cross-platform engineering design labs, infrastructure, and faculty systems.

End-user support of faculty and staff computing services.
